meaning: Independent typed Workflow input/result capture, source expression evaluation and actual deferred call comparison. Materialization establishes structure and occurrence custody, not commit or business-rule validity.
source_binding: Require a branded checked Workflow and compiled source graph with the same complete source certificate before accessing authored bindings. Pin these definition bytes. No generated materializer, expression renderer, production outcome evaluator or recovery planner supplies expected values.
capture: Copy the entire inert caller graph before any typed normalization or suspension. Own enumerable data properties only; no symbols, accessors, coercion or mutable caller aliases. Allow null-prototype ordinary objects; arrays require Array.prototype and dense own elements. At most 20000 visits, depth 64, 2048 own keys, 1024 array elements. Undefined values, cycles, non-finite numbers and functions reject. Proxy trap isolation is not claimed.
domain_values: Reuse independently interpreted source primitive, named Entity/Value Object/Enum, optional, list, set and sum semantics. Exact UInt64 retains bigint; nested missing ordinary optionals become null. Lists preserve occurrences, sets reject duplicate semantic keys and use canonical order. Entity equality uses identity, Value Object equality uses state. Explicit to_set keeps the first source representative for equal keys. No implicit unwrap or dereference.
event_inputs: Independently normalize Event input only, not an Event envelope. Preserve optional payload absence, signed 64-bit integers, finite decimals, nonempty reference/identity/time fields, required occurredAt versus generated-time omission. Never call a clock or manufacture generated time. Event fields are not UInt64 domain fields.
custody: Captured input and result slots are frozen, private registered objects. Each result belongs to that exact capture, source step and action. Forward arguments require the exact preceding source prefix. Compensation arguments require a prefix reaching for_step but expressions retain only their authored static scope. Final result requires every source step. Reject cloned, reordered, duplicate, future and cross-capture slots without reading hostile accessors.
expressions: Interpret only checked input, step-result, ontology-property projection, scalar literal, payload-free named variant and explicit to_set expressions. Preserve source collection projection semantics. No query, Mapping, Calculation, Operation or compensation is called by the value reference.
ownership_boundary: Reference structural capture accepts a well-shaped value even if it violates a business invariant. Actual Operations retain selected owned factory/Rule validation, observed separately using native fixture ports. Invariant references alone do not create validators. Immutable reference outputs do not share mutable caller storage.
native_fixture: Compare reference captures, every forward argument, committed result slot, compensation argument and final value against strict native compilation. For actual generated Workflows, hold begin and commit promises explicitly, mutate caller inputs after entry, and prove no successor call or final return before settlement. Retain R08ac1 independent settlement/recovery expectations. No additional Workflow transaction or compensation execution.
evidence: Finite source/native cases, hostile data, nested type distinctions, source/step/capture identity and compiling mutations. A compiling mutant must run and disagree with the independent reference; a compiler rejection is not a behavioral mutation witness.
compatibility: Add private reference and tests, register their proof command and synchronize developer evidence. Preserve existing source contracts, generators, capsule, public API and defaults. Public Workflow binding/audits/capacity/custody remain R08ac3. No install, provider deployment, admission, publication or release.
claim_ceiling: Local finite typed-value and call-order evidence, not storage durability, automatic recovery, exactly-once execution, public Workflow semantic coverage or CLI completion. Full R08-R18 remains active.
